description: Send a tip about a city: a place to add, a closed place, somewhere nearly impossible to book, or a wrong fact. Public. A tip is never published; an editor reviews it first. Rate limited per sender.

contact.description: How to reach the sender, at most 200 characters (optional).

locale.description: Language the tip is written in, a BCP 47 tag (default en).

persona.description: Persona slug the tip is about, if any.

step_ref.description: What the tip is about: '<day index>/<step index>' of the itinerary, or a venue id.

name: submit_tip
title: Send a local tip
